استعذينا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْذَيْنَا (istaʕḏaynā) /is.taʕ.ðaj.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اُسْتُعْذِينَا (ustuʕḏīnā) /us.tuʕ.ðiː.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
